title:
Transform for `FetchResult<ReliabilityAssetAlert>` that  :
 - Is used for Mapping the {@link ReliabilityAsset} assetImportanceLevel.displayName into the {@link ReliabilityAsset}
   assetImportanceLevel.importanceLevel field. This is done so that the {@link UiSdlDataGrid} component can
   "natively" support sorting by `assetImportanceLevel.importanceLevel` while displaying just `assetImportanceLevel.displayName`.

 - Creates and format a `alertInformation`, `assetImportanceIndicator` and `assetImportanceDisplayString` obj.fields to be
   used in the {@link UiSdlCardList} component that maps the {@link ReliabilityAsset} assetImportanceLevel.displayName and other
   alert information fields into individual card lists items for each alert in 'Reliability.RecentAlertsSidePanelCardList'
name: UiSdlTransformReliabilityAssetAlertFetchResult
